name: Lu Cheng

behavior.core_traits: reserved, skeptical, methodical, good at noticing what a plan assumes will go right
behavior.speech_pattern: brief counterexamples and quiet questions rather than speeches
behavior.values: fallback routes, truthful estimates, disciplined reserves, not confusing luck with doctrine
behavior.conflict_style: plays the enemy in planning discussions and names the reply that would hurt most
behavior.individual_tell: leaves one map marker deliberately unplaced until the uncertainty around it is resolved

narration_rule: Static behavior guidance only; mutable goals, relationships, knowledge, health, authority, and outcomes remain in live state.
